$comment: Completion bar for #17: the main window had no will-navigate/setWindowOpenHandler guards, sandbox was off, and the CSP allowed 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' and broad connect-src in production — so a target=_blank link (Media 'Watch' or the YouTube iframe logo) could open a remote-origin Electron window with the full window.lkv IPC surface, and XSS could escalate. Fix: deny window.open (route http/https to shell.openExternal), block non-app top-frame navigation, enable sandbox, and use a strict production CSP (script-src 'self', connect-src 'self') with a relaxed CSP injected only in dev. Criteria 1-4 fail before the change (guards/sandbox absent, 'unsafe-eval' present); 5-7 guard typecheck, build, and the rest of the suite. Electron fuses are a packaging step and are tracked separately (not asserted here).

criteria.target: npm run test:mvp && npm run test:media
